name: clarity-preserves-profile
description: Documentation drafting retains the Kubernetes rubric and suggests optional clarification without running it. Stage test-files as a workspace root; capture final output and tool trace. The empty Kustomize input is a filename-detection fixture, not a deployed workload.
prompt: Use /kk:document for the preparation-only overlay in infra/. Update only docs/operations.md for operators using infra/decision.md and the empty overlay as evidence. Keep the inherited platform reference. No deployment, new architecture decision or external research is needed; report unsupported details as such.
trap: The agent retains an automatic editorial pass or treats its removal as permission to drop rubric topics, N/A reasons, inherited citations or output boundaries.

assertions.text: Trace detects k8s from kustomization.yaml and loads its document index and rubric before full feature reads; neither clarify-docs nor the shared clarity procedure is loaded.
Only docs/operations.md is updated, without a separate clarity pass; unrelated.md, platform.md and infra/ remain unchanged and no summary file or recursive skill invocation appears.

The result covers RBAC/PSS, rollback, resource baseline, cluster compatibility and network/egress posture via supported content, explicit N/A with reasons or the inherited platform citation; it invents no deployed resources, measurements or compatibility validation.
The guide explains that the overlay currently emits no resources and the workload is future work; it retains the workload-owner/next-step limitation and working platform link.

The response suggests optional /kk:clarify-docs naming only docs/operations.md without executing it, claiming independent verification, or presenting clarification as a required gate or a replacement for project review.
